nom: RoC Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing 2-Step Peel Pads

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin overwhelmingly report the pads didn't bother their skin at all, with no burning, stinging or breakouts; one reviewer who doesn't normally react to new products instead found her skin turned red and slightly itchy after her first use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s, including some describing their skin as mature or aging, report smoother, firmer, more youthful-looking skin and fewer visible fine lines, wrinkles or dark spots; one notes the retinol needed a good moisturizer alongside it to stay gentle on her mature skin.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports tighter-looking pores, a glowier and more youthful look, and good tolerance with no breakouts, though she hadn't yet seen her pigmentation fade after 20 treatments.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who specifically mentions dry skin credits the treatment with smoothing her dry skin and minimizing wrinkles and lines.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly smoother, less noticeable fine lines and wrinkles within one to a few weeks, along with firmer, more youthful-looking skin, including several in their 40s and 50s; a handful of reviewers instead report no noticeable change in their fine lines even after two or more weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the pads as hydrating rather than stripping, crediting ingredients like hyaluronic acid and glycolic acid in step one, and say skin feels plump, soft and moisturized rather than dry after use.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or retinol-reactive skin, report no burning, stinging or irritation even on first use; a few others describe mild tingling, slight redness or light burning in the first day or two, which several say settled down or was managed by spacing out applications.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report dark spots or hormonal pigmentation looking lighter or less visible after weeks of use; one reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin instead saw no fading of her pigmentation after 20 treatments and wonders if more time is needed.
concerns.blemishes: The two reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone report the treatment did not cause new breakouts or irritate their skin.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who addresses oiliness directly says the treatment doesn't leave skin feeling greasy or heavy afterward.

aspects.libelle: Considered a bit pricey by some
Pads well saturated without being drippy

extraits.texte: I have to honestly say that after 2 1/2 weeks, I haven't noticed any difference. Maybe I didn't give it long enough to make any changes. I will say this is a quick and easy treatment. Very convenient packaging when traveling.

I received a free sample of RoC Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing 2-Step Peel Pads, in exchange for my opinion. This came in nice, convenient packaging, and was easy to use. I'm giving 4 stars because my skin seemed more sensitive to something in it; I usually don't have any issues but my skin got a little red and slightly itchy after using. Be mindful of the directions: it says to use every other day when starting - I would probably add an extra day, and you can't go out in the sun without sunblock for like a week after using the product. I would probably try this in more like fall or spring. If I didn't have a mild reaction when first using, I would probably keep trying this longer. My skin did seem smoother after using, but I would prefer to use something that I don't have a reaction from. Overall, this was just an okay skincare product for me; just be cautious when first using.

I paid for this product with my own money this is NOT a sponsored review!! I would give this product 4.5 stars. At first i would use occasionally or like once or twice a week as i like to rotate skin care. I think you will see the biggest difference if used more consistently. I then tried using everyday for 7-10 days in a row. I definitely saw improvement in my skin pores looked tighter, my skin looked glowy and overall younger. Makeup also looked much better. I hace combo skin that can be acne prone. This was well tolerated no break outs or reactions. My skin is tan olive and tgis worked well for me. I took off half a star as i didn't really see any fading of some pigmentation but msybe i need more time its only been 20 treatments. I would def recommend this product. Im hoping Roc even comes out with a stronger version.

I've tried a lot of retinol products over the years, but the RoC Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing 2-Step Peel Pads have quickly become one of my favorites. I love that the treatment is simple—just two steps—and doesn't require a lot of time or effort. After the first few uses, my skin felt noticeably smoother and looked brighter. Over the next couple of weeks, I started seeing a softer appearance in my fine lines, especially around my forehead and mouth. My complexion also looked more even, and my skin had a healthy glow that I hadn't seen in a while. I was a little nervous since I have mature skin and retinol can sometimes be irritating, but these pads were surprisingly gentle as long as I followed up with a good moisturizer. I use them in the evening a couple of times a week, and by the next morning my skin feels refreshed, smoother, and looks more radiant. If you're looking for an easy at-home treatment to help with texture, dullness, and the appearance of fine lines without adding a complicated routine, I definitely think these peel pads are worth trying. They've earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine.

I started using the ROC Line SmoothingPeel Pads as soon as they arrived because I like to test a product for at least a full couple weeks before I judge. I noticed immediately my dark spots seemed less visible and my face was definitely brighter and had a more youthful appearance.I am not young will turn back the clock but I will say that it has made a big difference in my skins texture and tone! I received this free from pinchme for the purpose of my review!

extraits.titre: I will never be without this!
extraits.texte: This Roc retinol treatment is the best product I've used in years for smoothing dry skin, minimizing wrinkles and lines and giving my skin a youthful glow. Along with the visual difference it helps my other skincare work better.

The RoC Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing 2-Step Peel Pads have made a noticeable difference in my skin. I have been using the pads for two weeks now and love the way my skin has responded to the treatments. The first step is the peel, and the second step is the smooth. They are applied once a day, which is very easy with no fuss. I have sensitive skin and it worked well with it. Many beauty products are harsh on my skin, but this product did not bother my skin at all, only improved it. I highly recommend this product to others who are looking for an anti-aging product that works well and is safe for sensitive skin. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
